cars.variant: 275-hp Performance Package six-speed manual — 2019 USA production-launch reference
cars.specification_market: 2019 USA Veloster N with optional 275-hp Performance Package and six-speed manual, specified by Hyundai Motor America’s 24 October 2018 production-launch release. Separate second-generation Veloster road programme from the PD-based i30 N; not a renamed i30 or N Line trim. Count this Veloster N family once across outputs, model years and later DCT. Not the ordinary 1.6 Turbo/R-Spec, mid-engine RM development car, TCR or ETCR racer. The award is for the 2020 competition, published November 2019; it is programme context, not a claim that the selected 2019 specification is a different award-winning generation. No i30 PS-to-hp substitution, January estimated launch figures, later N Grin Shift, measured acceleration, curb mass or price imported.
cars.summary: The Veloster N earned Road & Track’s 2020 Performance Car of the Year award through road-and-track evaluation. The award recognizes unusually engaging, accessible handling rather than outright speed; the testers also noted limited engine character and awkward pedal spacing. It represents the distinctive second-generation Veloster N road programme once, not extra entries for gearbox choices or model years.
